payload.rationale: This sprint retro touches the product's core positioning thesis (anti-Slack, decisions evaporate, capture at consensus, zero-effort capture), the Zephyr integration unlock, the thesis-proven claim, the webhook architecture decision, and the pricing thread ($12→$15). I expanded all four narratives and their child positions because this document could extend, confirm, or revise any of them — especially Position_Sprint4ThesisProven and Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, which a new retro at a later date (2026-09-21) would directly bear on. I also included Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint since it was the stated next-sprint focus and this retro may report on it. I did not expand the Documents door further or the Thematic/People/Unplaced doors since the perspective already surfaced every load-bearing node for this document's themes.
